rules.name: cs-14-swap-legs-sample-clients-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT c.client_code, c.contract_number, c.trade_id, c.derivative_type, c.currency, c.traded_price, c.active_lots, c.settle_price, c.future_price, c.mult_factor, c.mtm_nc, c.mtm_usd, c.maturity_date, c.contract_month, b.future_expiry_date, b.sub_account FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(bo.future_expiry_date) AS future_expiry_date, max(bo.sub_account) AS sub_account FROM opera.client_statement_booking_order_information_table bo WHERE bo.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND lower(bo.business_unit) = 'cfs' AND bo.contract_number = regexp_replace(c.contract_number, '[ABC]$', '')) b ON true WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.derivative_type = 'future' AND c.client_code IN ('BFA', 'LIB', 'NFO', 'AST', 'AMC', 'FMP', 'IOL', 'JUP') ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

expect.reason: swap legs of the sample clients
